Read the run log

Source: R/run_log.R
read_run_log.Rd

With options(pdmS7.run_log = "path/to/runs.csv") or the environment variable PDMS7_RUN_LOG set, every call of run_pdm(), and so sim_pdm() and sim_snow_pdm(), appends one row to that CSV file: when, who (declared name and login), an optional tag from options(pdmS7.run_tag = ), the model's pdm_fingerprint(), a checksum of the forcing, the period, engine and versions, run time, and whether the run succeeded, with the error message if not. With a register set (see approved_configurations()), approval is approved, superseded or unapproved, with the project and sign-off entry matched. Without one it is empty.

Usage

read_run_log(path = .run_log_path())

Arguments

path

Path of the run log.

Value

A data.table, one row per run; timestamp, start and end are UTC date-times.

Details

Calibration evaluations, spin-up cycles and the calibration log's own reruns are not logged. Logging is off unless the option or variable is set, and a logging failure warns once without stopping the run. A lock serialises writers, so a team can share one file.

Examples

log <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
old <- options(pdmS7.run_log = log, pdmS7.run_tag = "example")
run_pdm(pdm_model(), data.frame(rain = c(0, 5, 0), pet = 0.1))
